summary: Coeptis Therapeutics Holdings (formerly Z Squared, Inc.) filed an 8-K on April 27, 2026, announcing supplemental info on a previously disclosed pro rata dividend distribution of shares in its subsidiary Coeptis Holdings, Inc. to shareholders of record as of January 2, 2026. Each holder receives one non-transferable Coeptis Holdings share per Z Squared share held. The distribution was effected April 27, 2026, and Z Squared common stock began trading under ticker ZSQR on Nasdaq that same day. This spin-off separates the pre-combination biopharmaceutical business from the post-combination computing infrastructure company. Watch for trading dynamics and potential value dislocation between parent and distributed shares.
